sec: sec:C008: Monitor AI risk categories / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:C008: Monitor AI risk categories / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Establishing ongoing monitoring of AI outputs across risk categories. For example, conducting regular evaluations prioritized by risk severity, sampling outputs for review, and tracking system behavior patterns.
